parse.title: Boxer
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 14 - Sword Art Online Update - 16 June 2023

Overview

Boxer is a Exclusive unit. He is a Tournament-exclusive (preceding Wukong and succeeding Stitches), only obtainable by clearing the tournament on the 99.00% ~ 99.89% ranking reward, with his shiny being the 99.90% ~ 100% ranking reward.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Boxer's final attack has the highest hit count for any unit in the game! He is followed by Berserker (Rage) at 6 Multi Hits in his 2nd to last attack.
